<h2>Build Interim Trait Review Closure</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Converts fully investigated candidates without objective correction evidence
into approved no-action decisions. Nonpositive invalid values become narrow
exclusions, while corroborated scale or source patterns remain exceptions.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>build_trait_review_interim_closure(
  data_trait_review_candidates,
  data_trait_review_decisions,
  data_candidate_triage,
  data_candidate_reconciliation,
  reviewer,
  reviewed_at,
  evidence_reference
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_review_candidates">data_trait_review_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current trait-review candidates.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_review_decisions">data_trait_review_decisions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Existing trait-review decisions.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate_triage">data_candidate_triage</code></td>
<td>
<p>Programmatic candidate triage.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_candidate_reconciliation">data_candidate_reconciliation</code></td>
<td>
<p>Programmatic reconciliation results.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="reviewer">reviewer</code></td>
<td>
<p>Name of the approving human reviewer.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="reviewed_at">reviewed_at</code></td>
<td>
<p>ISO review date.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="evidence_reference">evidence_reference</code></td>
<td>
<p>Path to the durable closure report.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A named list containing the closure audit, new approved decisions,
unresolved exceptions, and a closure summary.
</p>

</main>
